reviewBasis: MAATAA-authored tenant/workspace integrity corrections; exact affected contract set and closure-bound provider previews.

decisions.decision: All five workspace-owned records reference workspaces by (workspace_id, organisation_id); direct organisation references remain explicit.

Membership references carry workspace and organisation scope. Optional actor/inviter references restrict membership deletion until the actor reference is explicitly cleared; favourites cascade with membership deletion.
Invited roles are referenced by (role_id, workspace_id, organisation_id); roles cannot be deleted while invitations refer to them.

contracts.name: workspace_activity
contracts.description: Non-compliance workspace activity feed. Canonical compliance/audit history remains in evidence.audit_events.

contracts.name: workspace_favourites
contracts.description: Per-membership workspace favourites for navigable resources.

contracts.name: workspace_invites
contracts.description: Workspace invitation records. Invite secrets are stored only as hashes.

contracts.name: workspace_roles
contracts.description: Workspace-scoped role definitions. Permission payloads are policy references, not the canonical identity permission registry.

contracts.name: workspace_settings
contracts.description: One settings document per workspace, scoped to its organisation tenant.

contracts.name: workspace_memberships
contracts.description: Workspace-level access grant carrying organisation_id so the workspace reference can enforce tenant-consistent membership.

contracts.name: workspaces
contracts.description: Named collaboration boundary inside one organisation. Composite (id, organisation_id) key supports tenant-safe child references.
